# dsh-starred-turns
Bookmark turns from the conversation's right-edge **turn rail** — the column of short dashes where e
ach dash marks one turn and jumps back to it when clicked. A bookmarked dash grows to the rail's ful
l length and takes the accent colour, so a specific turn stays easy to find in a long conversation.
Right-click a dash to bookmark it; right-click again to unbookmark.
中文说明
## Why
A long conversation gives you a rail of identical dashes. The shipped rail already distinguishes the
*active* turn, but nothing lets you mark the turns *you* care about — the decision, the diff, the a
nswer you keep scrolling back to. This plugin adds exactly that one bit per turn, and makes it visib
le at a glance by reusing the rail's own "full length" geometry.
## Features
- **Right-click to bookmark a turn.** The dash grows from its resting length (`scaleX` 0.4 for turns
not loaded into the transcript, 0.6 for loaded ones) to the rail's full width (`scaleX` 1), and swi

tches from the neutral border colour to the accent colour.
- **Bookmarks are per conversation.** Tur
n 5 in one conversation and turn 5 in another are different places; the conversation key is the sele

cted Session id.
- **Bookmarks persist.** They survive reloads and, on the Desktop build, app restar

ts.
- **No layout shifts.** The rail keeps its fixed 10px pitch; only the dash's own `scaleX` change

.
- **No layout shifts.** The rail keeps its fixed 10px pitch; only the dash's own `scaleX` changes.

## How it fits in without touching the chat package
The rail is drawn by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` and is not slot-extended, so the plugin decor
ates it from the outside rather than forking the package. Each dash is:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
with the visible dash supplied by a `::before` pseudo-element:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
So the plugin does three things, all from the outside:
1. a capture-phase `contextmenu` listener on `document` toggles the bookmark for the dash under the

pointer;
2. a `MutationObserver` (watching `data-index` and child insertion) plus a store subscripti

on keep a `data-dsh-starred-turn` attribute painted on the right dashes;
3. its stylesheet turns tha
t attribute into `scaleX(1)` in the accent colour.
Bookmarking deliberately reuses the dash's own `scaleX` geometry instead of changing width or height
, which is what keeps the rail's pitch intact.
The observer never watches the plugin's own attribute — it writes that attribute, so an unguarded ob
server would retrigger itself forever. Paints are also guarded by a read of the current attribute fo
gger itself forever. Paints are also guarded by a read of the current attribute for the same reason.
## Storage
Bookmarks live in a client store named `dsh.starred-turns.v1`, keyed by conversation:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The shell backs `persist` with `localStorage`. On the Desktop build the page origin is the stable `d
sh-app://app` scheme, so bookmarks survive app restarts there. On a plain browser the Host picks a n
ew loopback port per launch and browsers scope `localStorage` by origin including the port, so bookm
arks do not carry across restarts in that mode.
